title: Skeleton, contracts, vendoring (serial, first)
description: git init the repo at /blue/adamginsburg/adamginsburg/repos/portalkit. Write pyproject (numpy, astropy; extras thumbs/extinction/test; console script portalkit). Write constants.py and constants.js exactly as in section 6.12. Write schema.py validators for every JSON document in sections 4-5 (pk-page/1, pk-portal/1, pk-catalog/1, pk-records/1, pk-images/1, pk-hips/1, pk-overlays/1, pk-narrative/1, pk-templates/1, pk-filters/1, pk-extinction/1, pk-isochrones/1, pk-features/1, products/1, pk-deploy/1); each validator returns a list of errors. Copy the GC modules byte-for-byte and apply only the 3-line theme patch in renderer.js (section 6.11); record sha256 values in VENDORED.md. Write the test markers, the AST no-broad-except scanner (bare except, or Exception/BaseException without re-raise) and the constants sync test (it also re-hashes vendored files). Commit.

title: Python bundle writers and codecs
description: Implement section 5 exactly. codec.py holds gz() verbatim from GCTreasury_Portal_Manifold.py (level 9, mtime 0, OS byte; filtered variant), all encoders in the section 5.3 table, the shuffles, str and sparse, and dim_stats/log_dim_stats. catalog.py turns a CatalogSpec into the manifest, column files, chunking, ids/aliases, limits, row chunks (exact_rows rule) and the auto-encoding table. order.py implements the LOD permutation and the tile/morton sort with _src_index. records.py implements the pks1/pki1/json/sedcurve writers and the shard packer (target 256 kB, max 512 kB, layout file fallback). density.py writes pre-binned u16log grids and binned statistics. writer.py handles content-hash naming (h8 = sha256 of bytes) in .bin files, atomic writes inside staging, and the budget ledger. Golden fixtures are bytes plus expected decoded JSON consumed by WP05 node tests.

title: Physics resources (filters, extinction, templates, isochrones, features, SED)
description: Build the filter registry from the existing SVO caches and jwst_vega_zeropoints.ecsv: key, label, instrument, wl_um, weff_um, zp_jy, system. Compute G23 A_lambda/A_V per filter for R_V 3.1 and 5.5; dust_extinction is optional (except ImportError), and a vendored ecsv is the default. Split jwst_template_spectra.json into one pks1 file per (template, grid), about 20 kB each, plus the k31/k55 laws; extend_to_um hooks Brick2221 build_extended_templates. Wrap the MIST track loaders from WD2_Portal_Manifold (load_mist_table, build_isochrone_track) to produce IsochroneSpec. Write feature atlases from JWST_Archive_ColorPortal.py:123-242, Brick2221 FEATURE_FAMILIES:122-135 and the W51 lists. sed.py holds the mag<->Jy and nuFnu reference implementations. Write golden JSON for the JS tests.

title: Spec dataclasses, capability resolver, config assembly, shell
description: Implement the section 9.1 dataclasses and helpers (catalog_from_rows, join, ImageSetSpec.from_rows, standard_pages). caps.py implements the section 8.1 flag derivation and rules, including the added collapsed panes. config.py assembles page.json (section 4.3); it validates every key and expression against manifests, validates pane options (section 6.10) and the 64 kB cap. expr.py implements the section 4.4 grammar. shell.html is under 8 kB: viewport meta, inline theme pre-script, CSS links from {assets}, the #pk-page JSON with '</' escaped, a module script that imports boot.js, a noscript message, and an onerror fallback note if the assets fail. markdown_lite produces sanitized HTML for headings, lists, tables, code and links only.

title: Deploy: exposure, staging, ownership, replace/backup/rollback, verify, status, devserver
description: Implement section 11 exactly. The exposure classifier works over a configurable root pair; tests use a fake tree that mirrors the verified symlinks. deploy.py implements the ownership manifest, the lstat symlink refusal, the pk-tmp + fsync + os.replace order (data, then portal.json, then HTML) and the stub/inplace replace. backup.py implements backup.json with md5 and rollback. verify.py uses urllib (no requests), downloads to a temporary file and hashes it, and checks 401 vs 200. htaccess.py writes the optional .htaccess. devserver.py is a ThreadingHTTPServer with options for basic auth, Range on/off, a Content-Encoding mode (auto adds gzip for .gz like a misconfigured Apache, none, or gzip) and latency; it is used by CLI serve and all e2e tests. Catch only specific exceptions (OSError, urllib.error.HTTPError, ...).

title: JS data layer and workers
description: Implement the section 6.6 APIs exactly. Use one module worker per catalog dataset. Fetch with a gzip-magic check, then DecompressionStream, with inflate.js (a port of tiny-inflate with its MIT header) as fallback. The shard LRU is 16 MiB; the record LRU is 64 entries with tokens that drop stale responses. project.js reuses vendor kernel.projectRange when support <= 28, and uses a sparse loop otherwise. select.js applies brushes only to drawable rows (lasso even-odd with bbox prefilter). sky.js holds skyWindow (viewport filter over LOD order, cap 20k) and the dec-sorted crossmatch. find.js handles id, alias, substring and sexagesimal/decimal cone search. export.js writes CSV, JSON, the ID list and DS9 regions. Physics helpers match WP02 golden values to 1e-6 relative.

title: JS core, layout, CSS tokens
description: Implement sections 6.1-6.5, 6.7 and 6.8 and section 12. boot follows the documented order and sets body data-caps and data-tier. The store has rAF-coalesced topics, sync mode and events. Selection has the frozen semantics, undo depth min(20, floor(64MiB/n)), recipes and the ids/bits/r serialization. hash binds with replaceState debounced at 250 ms, with pushState on focus; legacyhash.js (WP13) is imported dynamically only when page.legacy.grammar is set. The layout has splitters, folds, pop-out, mobile tabs below 900 px and try/catch localStorage persistence. fmt.stepDigits gives step-aware precision. registry maps pane type to module path. testhooks are active only with ?pktest=1.

title: Rendering primitives: XYRenderer, budget, canvas2d, axes, overlays, brush UI, fold/tour/compass
description: XYRenderer (section 6.9) reuses vendor ACCUM_FS_CONT, ACCUM_FS_CAT, COMPOSITE_FS, DOWN_FS, BLUR_FS and FINAL_FS. New XY_VS emits the same varyings (v_w, v_c, v_has, v_sel, flat v_code). MARKER_VS/FS handle tier T1. budget.js implements the section 7.5 plan. fold.js implements section 7.3, including dm and the constant folded into the camera. tour.js wraps vendor frame.geodesic/blendFrames with drift and per-axis play. canvas2d handles T0 styling and SVG export. overlays.js handles dim-space overlays with coverage fade, pairs connectors, isochrones, vectors and cut lines. brushui has rect/circle/lasso with modifier-to-op mapping via selection.opFromEvent.

title: Plot panes: scatter, manifold, hist + controls
description: scatter and manifold implement the tier table in section 7.1, including the semantic-zoom switch, context density, raster PNG layers, pre-binned first paint, small multiples (grid option) and per-pane pop-out. manifold wires the GC Renderer when support <= 28 and XYRenderer otherwise, plus tour/compass/presets and missing-data fade. controls handles av/rv/dm sliders, colour-by, the template picker and features toggles. axis_picker has grouped optgroups with counts, prev/next/play and typed expressions. chips cover category, flag, S/N-tighten, saved selection and preselect chips. legend shows counts and category toggles. hist provides the range brush that writes filters.ranges.

title: Sky panes: sky, wavelength, narrative + Aladin layer
description: aladin.js loads the CDN, then the mirror, then shows an error note, with an 8 s timeout. It keeps one instance per page, a command queue before ready, and feature detection for the layer/opacity API drift. layers.js handles base and overlays with opacity, overlays off/defaults and lazy FITS overlays. markers.js has one A.catalog per category and skyWindow LOD markers up to 20k, with a sampled notice. overlays.js handles polygons, boxes, circles, rings and shapes. skybrush.js does circle/rect on the sky through DataClient.brush with sky ViewRef. wavelength.js does the asymmetric cross-fade with step fallback, play/speed and markers. narrative.js uses IntersectionObserver beats; scene exit removes overlays; suppress_view. aladin_stub.js implements the section 13 API list and records calls.

title: Spectrum panes: spectrum1d, spectrum2d, SED, features
description: spectrum1d supports pan, wheel, box and pinch; autoY on the visible range; variants; segment toggles; band jumps; pin up to 8; rubber band; velocity offset; mask shading; filter transmission shading; reddened templates scaled over configurable bands; sed mode (log-log). spectrum2d supports pki1 (colormap, stretch) and PNG mode, with the x axis linked to store spec.xr. sed supports Fnu/nuFnu, limits as arrows, templates/blackbody/sedcurve models and a fullscreen dialog with nearest-point tooltip. features.js does atlas rendering with collision dropping and requires_coverage dashing.

title: List/detail/gallery/table/readme/landing panes + UI widgets
description: list is virtualized for any N, with search through DataClient.find, sort and a selection-only view. detail has templates, the property table with click-to-axis, figures, products, bars, prose and links; it prefers exact rows. gallery has a virtualized card grid, roles, facets with counts, presets, lazy images, hover, annotate mode and mini panes through the layout. landing has cards from portal.json, counts from manifests, global search and readme blocks. hover is an edge-flipping card. lightbox works over the filtered set with lb= hash clear and swipe. export handles CSV/JSON/IDs/DS9 and import by id, alias or 0.3 arcsec position. nav renders portal.json, carry, login-required badges and related links. help lists enabled and disabled caps with reasons and the keymap. annotate stores codes y/n/g/w/l/e in localStorage and exports a CSV with the checklist key columns; it never writes server files.

title: Test harness: synthetic fixtures, e2e smoke, caps matrix, perf, parity, contact sheet
description: make_synthetic.py builds section 13 Level 1 portals through bundle/physics/render directly (it does not depend on build.py). The e2e conftest starts devserver, launches Chromium with SwiftShader flags and routes aladin to the stub. Smoke, caps-matrix, deep-link and fallback tests follow section 13. Perf tests follow the Level 3 table. test_web_tree checks there is no package.json and that imports are relative. inventory_caps.json and port_table.json come from inventory.json and section 14. test_parity_inventory asserts that each page's resolver output is a superset of its legacy caps. contact_sheet.py writes paired screenshots to a review HTML. E2E tests that depend on panes from WP08-WP11 are marked xfail(strict=False) until those WPs land.

title: Legacy bridge, context, build orchestration, CLI
description: extract.py uses raw_decode at the three embed styles. manifold_payload converts stars/dims (v, k, center, scale, range, group, log, note)/groups/presets/categories to a CatalogSpec and ManifoldSpec, with k codes mapped to limit kinds. gc_manifest writes a pk-catalog/1 manifest whose file URLs point at GC files in place (u16 dims map to u16q, offsets to i16off, errs to u8log, meta to cat8). dirgallery scans a directory with named-group regex facets. importshim implements section 9.3. context implements the section 9.3 cache, keyed by path/mtime/size without pickle, and the input registry with tmp rejection. build.py runs the section 9.4 pipeline. cli.py implements the section 10 commands and exit codes. legacyhash.js implements all section 6.4 grammars. adapters/_template.py is a commented skeleton.

title: Adapter: sgrb2 (wave 1)
description: Tier A references the existing data/mapccd/*.f32.gz in place (enc f32, linear order). Tier B imports SgrB2_Portal_MapCCD loaders and re-encodes to u16q with LOD and pre-binned density. Pages: landing, sky explorer, map_ccd explorer (T2, GPU projection), SED gallery with live SED for all 2105 sources. Declared public (target classified both). Remove the hard-coded counts. The landing card that links the secure manifold triggers the public->secure badge.

title: Adapter: robitaille (wave 1)
description: 28,248 rows. Store 54 mags and 21 physical params; the 172 colours are virtual (CPU projection path, 75-83 base columns). FRIED becomes a category. The dm slider and the >30 mag at 8 kpc rule are client-side. Tier B caches the 4-hour read_geometry loop through ctx.cache. SED curves are written as sedcurve pks1 shards. The imaging gallery gets thumbnails via portalkit thumbs; imaging/gallery.html is merged and dropped from nav. Public.

title: Adapter: nirspec6927 core pages (wave 1)
description: Pages: landing, map explorer, manifold, specviewer, colorcolor, icecolumns, cogas, pvgallery, sedgallery, spectra_png gallery. Spectra go to pks1 shards and s2d FITS to pki1. MSA shutter and dither overlays. Per-grating products as records json. Secure: deploy must classify the target as secure. Uses NIRSpec_6927_AladinMap/Manifold through ctx.legacy.

title: Adapter: dirgallery_sites (wave 2)
description:
One registry covers about 45 autoindex/jQuery galleries: brick_2221 ccds_cmds (5 regex presets become one page), sed_figures legacy/top100, the public brick_2221/nirspec_6927 gallery, the 2640/6927 pngs galleries when they are not built by family adapters, robitaille png_b (secure) and modelgrids/ccds, the w51/sgrb2/wd2/wd1/cloudc galleries flagged by the critic, and mislabeled headers fixed. Each portal entry declares visibility and target.

Integrator additions (before launch): (a) WPE1 (58188c6) lets each [[portal.page]] legacy entry be a string or a table {file, preset?, replace?}: use one unified gallery page per directory family with per-file presets (e.g. the 5 brick_2221 ccds_cmds regex galleries become one page with five presets), and replace=false for legacy files behind served symlinks. (b) Ownership boundaries: do not map any legacy file that a family adapter owns. sites/nirspec6927.toml (WP22) owns nirspec_6927 pngs/gallery_6927*.html; WP25 (nirspec2640) owns the 2640 pngs gallery; WP26 (sickle_brick) owns the brick_2221/sed_figures_f1500w_all and sed_figures_top100_f1500w galleries, because they join the F1500W catalog (ARCHITECTURE §14.8), so leave sed_figures out of WP23 despite the original wording; WP24 (wd2) owns the wd2 SED gallery; WP28 (jwst_archive) owns the 11 archive spectra galleries; WP21 merged robitaille imaging/gallery.html into its imaging page. Use docs/port_table.json families and the §14 tables to decide; WP23 owns the critic's ~30 jQuery autoindex galleries (§14.1), robitaille png_b (secure) and modelgrids/ccds/gallery.html, the brick_2221 ccds_cmds galleries, and the public brick_2221/nirspec_6927/gallery.html (public page, no secure data). Record every directory considered and who owns it in the adapter's module docstring or a table in the site toml.

title: Adapter: wd2 (wave 3)
description: Pages: map_ccd explorer, colorcolor explorer, wd2_manifold (164 dims, CPU projection), sabbi manifold, SED gallery, wavelength explorer. Isochrones come from build_isochrone_track. Preselects become saved selections. 2640 spectra are shared by URL. Target is web/public/jwst/wd2/nirspec_2640/unified/wd2/.

title: Adapter: nirspec2640 (wave 3)
description:
Pages: landing, map, colorcolor (pairs connectors, BD hist split), specviewer, pvgallery, sedgallery, red_excess (binned-stat background), manifold, one pngs gallery with 3 role presets. Product links are rewritten to the secure archive URL with a login-required badge. Target is web/public/jwst/wd2/nirspec_2640/unified/nirspec2640/; this resolves the public-copy drift.

Integrator additions: (a) Put the generic NIRSpec helpers in a shared module portalkit/legacy/nirspec.py (with tests in tests/py/test_legacy_nirspec.py): stitch per-grating s2d FITS into one pki1 2D image (per-grating trim, pad, concatenate in wavelength order) and split a merged x1d at grating-overlap midpoints into segments. adapters/nirspec6927.py has working versions of both (read them; do not edit that adapter, the integrator will switch it over). (b) Legacy bugs to fix through the port: the public copies under /orange/adamginsburg/web/public/jwst/wd2/nirspec_2640/ have drifted from the secure originals (the unified pages replace them; record which legacy public files the unified target supersedes), and the 2640 icecolumns page is missing (the 6927 family has one: provide the equivalent page for 2640 if the ice-column fits exist, else record it as a gap with the missing inputs). Fix copy-pasted page titles.

title: Adapter: sickle_brick (wave 3)
description: Pages: Sickle MIRI SED map explorer (SESHAT bars, F2550W FITS overlay URL through exposure), Sickle manifold, Brick2221 F1500W explorer (extended templates to 26 um, k55, normalization bands that exclude the MIRI excess). The sed_figures galleries join the F1500W catalog. Sickle is declared public to match its current exposure, pending the open question.

title: Adapter: spherex (wave 4)
description: One shared catalog bundle feeds six pages: landing, colours explorer (Yoo locus overlay), browse spectra (cone search), map (bookmarks, Planck 857 overlay), sed (nuFnu toggle), manifold. Spectra go to pks1 shards. Replaces the rsync deploy_portal.sh flow with portalkit deploy. README deployed. Public.

title: Adapter: jwst_archive incl. W51 archive_colors build (wave 4)
description: Two [[portal]] entries: the archive portal (secure, jwst/spectra/portal_unified) and the W51 archive_colors build (secure, w51/portal/archive_colors/unified) with the W51 photometry as context dataset. Spectra ids are derived from the x1d filename prefix (fixes 695/1539 stale idx). Band-coverage validity bits. One archive gallery with facets replaces 11 legacy galleries (the PNGs are public through the web/public/jwst/spectra symlink, so the gallery portal is public and links to the secure colour portal). Checklist annotate mode plus archive-checklist-diff; never writes jwst_archive_spectra_checklist.csv (test enforces).

title: Adapter: w51 (wave 5)
description: Secure, at /orange/adamginsburg/w51/portal/unified (served via web/secure/w51/portal). Identity migration: positional ids with W51-000123 aliases. Two independent catalogs on map_ccd. GTC slits/tiers/rings overlays. spec2d PNG mode. Hexbin rasters plus 53k context density. spectra_candidate is BLOCKED until its tmp-scratchpad inputs are copied to /orange/adamginsburg/w51/gtc/candidate_xb5/ with user approval. The wavelength page uses rungs.

title: Adapter: gc_manifold (wave 5)
description: Foreign GC schema-1 manifests are referenced in place via legacy/gc_manifest (no re-encode). Treasury (3.74M) and 11 field pages use the T2 GPU path. The gc-query grammar is mapped 1:1. FEATURE_CAVEATS become caveats. The red-clump preset is kept. served_by external (starformation.astro.ufl.edu): deploy writes to jwst/releases/site/<field>_manifold/unified, and verify runs against the external URL. The monitor is registered with status excluded.

title: Adapter: nirspec6927 narrative pages + extras (wave 6)
description: MSATA scrollytelling (15 beats, acquisition boxes, highlight cleanup), H2 report (VERDICTS imported, rotation-diagram scatter when a line table exists), refstar map (rings tool; refstar_map_data.json has no writer, so it is rebuilt from NIRSpec_6927_RefStar inputs or extracted with Tier A), refstar_check contact sheets. Extras: hips_tours (RGB and ACES wavelength tours), spitzer_spectra (cmz), jwst_gc_aladin explorer, cmd_explorer pre-binned explorer. The narrative family deploys into the same nirspec_6927/unified target using a separate [[portal]] id, with page files prefixed n_ to keep ownership disjoint.

title: Integration: JS data layer (record channels, worker argsort, page-relative png, category default_off)
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 70 (hub category filters apply manifest default_off at open), 73 (DataClient.record(ds,i,{channel}) cancels only the previous request on the same channel; default channel keeps current behaviour), 74 (DataClient.order(key, dir) -> Int32Array worker-side argsort over all rows, NaN/missing last, key 'id' sorts ids; must handle 5M rows in the worker without main-thread work), 81 (pki1 png sidecar URLs resolve against the page URL per section 4.3, with {res}/{assets} substituted; fixes img/s2d/X.png 404 on spectra_png). Add unit tests for each.

title: Integration: JS core (gpuBudget, CSS loader, hash sentinels, titles, legacy page arg, importCsv, docs/js.md)
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 68 (boot creates one gl/budget.js Budget per page as app.gpuBudget, reachable from pane ctx), 69 (pane CSS loader maps scatter/manifold/hist to [<pane>.css, controls.css]; no 404s for any pane css), 71 (document narrative:highlight/narrative:sync events in docs/js.md), 72 (ovl=- encodes an explicitly empty overlay list; absent ovl = layout default; round-trip tests), 77 (layout seeds pane title from options.title; ctx.setTitle updates it), 90 (boot calls mapLegacy(grammar, {hash, search, page}) with the page JSON), 92 (sel= encoding chosen from the selection alone, shorter of r: and bits:, stable across reload), 93 (app.importCsv(text, {mode}) using ui/export.js parseImportText + resolveImport; returns counts). Update docs/js.md for every API added or changed in notes 68-93.

title: Integration: plot, spectrum and sky panes + model controls
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 68 (panes use ctx.app.gpuBudget; never create a Budget), 70 (chips only render category default_off state), 71 (scatter, manifold and sky listen for narrative:highlight {pane, ds, ids, beat, goto?} and narrative:sync {pane}), 73 (sed uses client.record(..., {channel:'sed'})), 75 (one A_V/R_V/template/feature-toggle implementation in ui/controls.js; sed.js modelControls and spec/features.js featureToggles mount it), 82 (Aladin library loads once per page; one viewer per sky pane), 91 (manifold <pane>.frame=<preset> accepts 'axes' presets by building a frame from the preset's two dims), and expose the scatter view geometry (data ranges, plot margins, kx/ky, log flags) in the pane's stats() so tests need not rebuild makeView margins. Move the WP08 unit tests from the scratch file wp_scratch/WP08/unit.mjs into tests/js/plotpanes.test.mjs and make them pass.

title: Integration: list/detail/gallery/table/readme/landing panes + UI widgets
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 74 (list and gallery sort through DataClient.order(key, dir), including id sort; remove the main-thread radix sort, SORT_MAX and the 500k export-ids cap path), 76 (list.js and gallery.js import isCategory/levelColors and colour helpers from ui/legend.js instead of local copies), 81 (image and product URL resolution: fix the doubled img/img/ prefix seen in the synthetic fixture detail pane; item URLs page-relative, product links relative to the records index URL), 85 (landing search opens a worker per search manifest lazily on first keystroke), 93 (the CSV import dialog calls app.importCsv when present). Add unit tests where logic is testable without a browser.

title: Integration: Python resolver, config validation, shell
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 78 (raster options accept x, y, cell; detail templates photometry and compact pass config/schema validation), 88 (caps.py default layout gives scatter and manifold options.overlays — isochrone track ids and '<law>_vector' — when iso/ext datasets are present and isochrones_or_tracks / extinction_vectors_on_ccd are on; manifold options.dims from its manifest on every page, consistent with what build.py already writes on gc-query/kv-view pages), 89 (hips_layer_stacking requires a HiPS document; live_sed_viewer requires a filters dataset; labeled_features_overlay requires a features dataset), 95 (portalkit.deploy re-exports raise_for_plan). Keep caps parity tests (tests/py/test_parity_inventory.py) green: a capability legacy pages had must still resolve on when its datasets exist.

title: Integration: test harness (shared browser plugin, fixture stamps, caps-matrix assertions, new fixture pages)
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 94 (browser fixtures move to tests/conftest_browser.py, registered as a plugin by tests/e2e/conftest.py and tests/perf/conftest.py so '-m "e2e or perf"' shares one Playwright; synthetic fixture reuse stamp hashes portalkit/**/*.py and web/** plus the generator). Fix: test_av_moves_template_and_isochrones must not use tpl=- and must use pane stats() not h.view(); chromium launched with --disable-accelerated-2d-canvas; screenshot comparisons hash canvas.toDataURL or use a longer timeout; the blocked-CDN fallback test ignores its expected console error. Add synthetic pages: a hist page and an uncollapsed scatter page. Replace the contract-issue xfails with real assertions for notes 81, 88, 89, 90, 91, 92, 93 (they will pass once WPI1-WPI5 land; the orchestrator runs them at gate G2).

title: Perf: canvas2d density uploads, list/hover/sky startup reads
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 99 and 103 (consume 100 via app.afterFirstPaint()). canvas2d.js drawDensityGrid: CPU-backed scratch context (willReadFrequently) and a cache of the colourised canvas keyed by (grid.counts, cmap, lo, hi, log), so each redraw is one drawImage; same in spectrum2d.js. hover.js reads the hovered row with client.record(i), never values(). list.js paints its first screen from client.rows(first,last) and loads full columns (pickHoverColumns etc.) on sort/filter/colour or after app.afterFirstPaint(); id cells come from the rows payload, not client.id(i) per row. sky/markers.js defers its ra/dec values() load until app.afterFirstPaint(). Evidence for each cause is in the perf diagnosis (scratchpad/unify/perfdiag/, report quoted in the run's extra notes).

title: Perf: worker chunked ids/record, chunk_starts, manifest prefetch, resolveIds, afterFirstPaint
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 98 (reader side: chunk ranges from manifest chunk_starts in chunksFor, prefix loads, id(i), record(i); fall back to ceil(n/chunk_rows) without it), 99 (worker record(i) does not call ensureIds when the row chunk carries id; id(i)/record(i) load only the ids chunk holding row i; find/query/export/order load all), 100 (boot.js app.afterFirstPaint()), 101 (worker manifest prefetch via ?m= query, open reuses the in-flight promise), 102 (DataClient.resolveIds one-pass worker op; boot.js app.resolveIds/importCsv use it instead of exporting the whole id list). Unit tests with synthetic chunk_starts manifests (write fixtures with portalkit.bundle where possible, or hand-built gz files).

title: Perf: bundle head chunk (chunk_starts), schema, first-paint ledger
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 98 on the writer side: for n > LOD_MIN_N write chunk_starts and split every column and the ids at [0, LOD_BASE) + CHUNK_ROWS slices; schema.py validates chunk_starts (strictly increasing ints starting at 0, last < n, len == number of chunk files for every chunked column and ids.chunks) and keeps the old ceil(n/chunk_rows) rule when it is absent. Update the first-paint ledger to count what first paint now reads (manifest, density grid, rows/r0000 or the head chunks of the list's visible columns and ids). Update docs/bundle.md and any goldens; Python readers in portalkit (codec/decoders used by tests and tools) must handle chunk_starts.

title: Cleanup: default_off round trip, widget CSS, Aladin prefetch retry
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 104 (legend toggleLevel keeps cats[key]=[] for default_off columns; hash.js keeps cats entries equal to []; round-trip tests through stateToHash/hashToState and hub default_off), 108 (move the shared widget rules into ui.css and remove the copies from sed.css, spectrum.css and controls.css; registry PANE_CSS stays consistent), 109 (a failed Aladin prefetch is retried once by the first sky pane that mounts).

title: Wave C: quantized record cells, deferred-pos consumers, Aladin retry in wavelength, chips default_off, ui.css order, JS docs
description: (1) data.worker.js record(i) on catalogs with row chunks merges quantized cell values (cellSource) for stored columns the row chunk omits (exact:false) and lists them in `_qkeys` (hover.js already reads `_qkeys`). (2) sky.js and wavelength.js do not await markers.refresh({force:true}) inside setup: call it without awaiting (then drawRings) and register positionChanged/zoomChanged/resizeChanged listeners and the narrative:sync emit right away; wavelength.js mounts through retryAladinOnce(app.page) like sky.js (note 109). (3) table.js: blocks read before first paint on a quantized catalog with positions are re-read after app.afterFirstPaint() (or read with {pos:true} after it). (4) sky.js highlight and detail.js focus reads pass {pos:true} so a highlight/focus set from the URL before first paint still gets coordinates. (5) chips.js calls legend.toggleLevel with {defaultOff: hasDefaultOff(meta)} (note 104). (6) boot.js loads css/panes/ui.css before mountLayout. (7) docs/js.md documents app.afterFirstPaint, DataClient.resolveIds and the worker resolveIds op, workerUrl(manifestUrl), rows/record opts.pos, allowPositions(), _posDeferred, `_qkeys`, the app-level hover record channel 'hover:card', and the current app.resolveIds path; ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.3 sel= rules match note 107, and the hover-card text (about line 673, 'never fetch row chunks') matches note 99.

title: Wave C: extinction-vector need, shared resource helper for fixtures
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 110. Add extinction_vectors_on_ccd -> 'extinction' to caps.NEEDS. Factor the resource-attachment rule of build._page_refs into one public helper (e.g. caps.attachable_resources(page, caps) or build.page_resources) that make_synthetic.resolve_page and test_caps_matrix._collect_pairs call instead of a hand-picked resources tuple. Wavelength/narrative overlay documents with a 'reddening' dim are listed in their pane's default overlays when the cap is on. The 3 failing caps-matrix cases test_capability[hist|wavelength|narrative-extinction_vectors_on_ccd] must pass (each either draws a vector or the cap is disabled with a reason), and test_parity_inventory must stay green.

title: Wave D: pane first-paint state, list deferred column reads, first-paint byte measurement
description: Implement IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 112. Measured on the 1M synthetic explorer (WPB3 probe): the list pane reports data-state=ready when mount() resolves, before rows/r0000 is fetched, so app.afterFirstPaint() resolves with only app JS + manifest loaded (973 kB) and the deferred reads (cls c000+c001, good, f115w c000+c001 = 2.1 MB from pickHoverColumns/class colouring; pos dra+ddec 2.9 MB) race the first screen. Fix: (1) layout awaits handle.firstPaint before 'ready' (guarded); list/table/gallery/scatter/manifold/hist expose it; (2) list hover columns and class colours read from the rows it holds (row records carry exact values; quantized fallback rows carry them too), full-column values() only on sort/filter/colour-by or idle after a quiet period; (3) testhooks __pk.firstPaintAt(); DevServer RequestRecord.t; test_perf_budget counts bytes finished before firstPaintAt and also reports bytes to quiet settle; wait_panes_settled unchanged in meaning (now correct because panes hold loading). Prove with a 1M and 50k probe: report bytes before first paint, first-paint time, and the order of requests (r0000 must finish before any deferred column/pos read starts).

title: Wave D: narrative beat hash determinism
description: G2 run at 656f853: tests/e2e/test_deep_links.py::test_legacy_beat fails 2 of 3 runs. Load narrative.html#beat=b3&x=1 -> canonical hash '#beat=b3' (stable 600 ms) -> reload -> '#sky=266.4368,-29.0078,0.14&ovl=fields,marks&beat=b3'. The narrative applies a beat by store.set({beat, sky:{...overlays, ra/dec/fov}}) (narrative.js ~180-203) and the sky pane writes the settled Aladin view back (sky.js writeView, SETTLE_MS) once Aladin is ready, so whether sky=/ovl= reach the hash depends on timing. Make it deterministic with this rule (port table msata: 'suppressView keeps user zoom; #beat= hash'): a view and overlay set that a beat applied is implied by beat= and is not written to the hash; once the user pans/zooms or toggles an overlay after the beat, sky=/ovl= are written; loading '#sky=..&beat=b3' keeps the hash's sky view over the beat's view. Aladin's rounding/aspect adjustment of a programmatic goto must not count as a user change. Prove with 10 consecutive passes of test_legacy_beat and the whole test_deep_links.py plus the narrative tests in tests/e2e (PK_SYNTH_DIR=<scratch>/WPD2/synth), plus unit tests for the rule.

title: Wave D: 50k first-paint gap
description:
Level 3 at 656f853 (host load ~120 on a 2-CPU cgroup, SwiftShader): explorer@50000 first_paint_s 3.49-4.31 s vs the 3.0 s budget; WPD1's request order shows rows/r0000 finished ~3.27 s BEFORE firstPaintAt, so ~3 s is spent after the data is in. Trace where (Playwright tracing/CDP Performance and the panes' firstPaint latch timings): which pane's latch resolves last, and what that pane waits on (WebGL program/first raster on SwiftShader, density grid colourise, idle callback FIRST_PAINT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS, layout guard, scatter waiting for full x/y columns instead of the head chunk/density grid). Fix what is ours: e.g. scatter first paint from the pre-binned grid or the LOD head chunk then progressive full draw; resolve afterFirstPaint without an idle wait longer than needed; avoid main-thread blocking work before first paint. Keep note 112 semantics (latch = first data-backed paint). Report before/after first_paint_s for 50k and 1M over >=3 interleaved runs each (python -m pytest tests/perf -m perf -q -k 'not 5000000', PK_SYNTH_DIR=<scratch>/WPD3/synth) and the trace breakdown. Do not change budgets.

Resume note (integrator, after the implementation pass): the fix step also owns web/css/base.css (make the .pk-skeleton shimmer static or opacity/transform-only, then simplify layout.js quietSkeletons accordingly) and tests/perf/test_perf_budget.py (load one untimed warm-up page in the browser before the timed explorer@50000 run so the measurement covers the page, not Chromium start-up). Re-measure 50k and 1M first_paint_s over >=3 runs after these changes.

title: Wave E: Python framework fixes from wave-1 adapter reviews
description:
Framework issues raised by the wave-1 adapters (WP20 sgrb2, WP21 robitaille, WP22 nirspec6927; their code is committed). Fix each in the framework, with tests:
1. Per-legacy-file preset and replace policy. PageConfig.preset is one hash fragment per page and applies to every legacy file of the page. Allow each [[portal.page]] legacy entry to be a string or a table {file, preset?, replace?}: preset is the hash fragment the deploy redirect stub for THAT legacy file appends (e.g. gallery_6927_2221.html -> gallery_6927.html#role=c2221); replace=false keeps that legacy path out of --replace stubbing (for legacy files behind a served symlink, e.g. robitaille imaging/ -> modelgrids/imaging_run/png, which today raises SymlinkRefusal). Spec dataclass (LegacyRef or the page legacy list), config assembly, schema validation, deploy stub writer and docs (ARCHITECTURE section on legacy redirects and site toml, docs/deploy.md). Then update sites/nirspec6927.toml so gallery_6927 maps pngs/gallery_6927.html, pngs/gallery_6927_2221.html (preset role=c2221) and pngs/gallery_6927_1182.html (preset role=c1182); check those legacy files exist under the nirspec_6927 legacy_dir first (read-only) and adjust paths to what exists.
2. portal.json 'search' lists only explorer/manifold catalogs, so landing cards for other pages (a map_ccd page on the same catalog, gallery pages over image sets, spectra/record pages) get no manifest-driven count and adapters fall back to build-time card text. Make the landing counts cover every page's primary dataset (catalog row count, image-set item count, record-set id count) in a schema-valid way (extend pk-portal/1 additively if needed, with the landing pane reading it only if it already supports it; do NOT edit web/js files: if the JS landing pane needs a change, record it in contract_issues with the exact field names).
3. Absolute local input paths (/orange/adamginsburg/..., /blue/...) are written into rendered page HTML and manifests (provenance / readme / build inputs). Rendered pages and served data must not carry absolute filesystem paths: replace them with a path relative to the site's declared input roots (legacy_dir / legacy_paths / data roots) or with the basename, prefixed by a stable label; keep the full paths in build_report.json only (that file is not deployed; confirm deploy excludes it, and make it so if not). Add a check in `portalkit check` (warning at G1, error at G2) that flags any absolute /orange/, /blue/, /home/ path in staged .html/.json files.
4. The first-paint estimator (portalkit/bundle/catalog.py first_paint_files and the build ledger) counts list-row chunks for context catalogues (context=True, used only as density/background layers) and, when exact_rows is off, counts the head chunk of every column. Context catalogues are never shown in a list pane: count only what the panes using them read at first paint (density grids). Then set exact_rows off for the 121,068-row `bg` context catalogue in adapters/nirspec6927.py (WP22 measured 6.3 MB of row files nobody fetches) and confirm the colorcolor first-paint estimate stays below 1 MB.
5. Build input registry efficiency: WP21 measured a 13-minute adapter test run because the build input registry (portalkit/context.py, input_sha256.json) walks large directories (robitaille seds/) on Lustre. Make the registry cheap: record directory inputs by (path, mtime, entry count) or by the files actually read, cache content hashes keyed by (path, size, mtime_ns), never hash or stat a whole tree when the adapter registered a directory. Measure before/after on the robitaille adapter's Tier A fixture build (python -m pytest tests/adapters/test_robitaille.py -m adapters -q -x, PK_CACHE_DIR=<scratch>/WPE1/cache) and report both timings.
6. Inventory family key: docs/inventory.json, docs/port_table.json, tests/data/inventory_caps.json and tests/data/port_table.json key the family as 'nirspec-6927' while the site/family id is 'nirspec6927'; tests/adapters/test_nirspec6927.py maps them with INV_FAMILY. Normalize every family key to the site ids (check the others too: sgrb2, robitaille, and the not-yet-ported families' keys against the sites they will get per ARCHITECTURE section 14) and drop the mapping. Keep tests/py/test_parity_inventory.py green.
Run: python -m pytest tests/py -q (whole python suite must stay green) plus the adapter tests you touch (tests/adapters/test_nirspec6927.py -m adapters; robitaille for item 5). Do not run e2e/perf here.

title: Wave E: JS follow-ups (landing counts, context density backdrop, flaky scatter test) and WPD2/WPD3 docs
description:
1. Landing counts. WPE1 added an optional `counts[]` array to pk-portal/1 (portal.json): each entry is {page, ds, kind: 'catalog'|'images'|'records'|..., n: int>=0, unit?, units?} (portalkit/build.py, ARCHITECTURE §4.2 and §9.3). web/js/panes/landing.js loadCounts still reads only the `search` manifests. Make it read `counts[]` first and render `n` with `unit` (n==1) or `units` on the `.pk-card-link[data-page=<page>]` card (sum or list per the spec when a page has several datasets), falling back to the `search` manifests when `counts` is absent. Unit tests in tests/js/listpanes.test.mjs; extend the landing check in tests/e2e/test_archetype_smoke.py if the synthetic portal has a landing page.
2. Context backdrop. scatter.js draws the context-catalogue backdrop by binning context columns in the worker (`bg.bin2d`). ARCHITECTURE §5.9/§5.11 say to draw the context catalogue's pre-binned `density[]` grid when its axes match the current axes and to bin in the worker only when they do not. WPE1 changed the first-paint ledger (catalog.first_paint_files(man, context=True)) to count only the manifest and density grids for context catalogues, so the JS must not fetch context columns before first paint when a matching grid exists. Implement, keep the canvas2d colourise cache path (WPD3/perfdiag), and test it.
3. Flaky test. tests/js/listpanes.test.mjs 'scatter: firstPaint resolves at the first data draw; a failed x/y load rejects it' fails about 1 in 5 runs, also when run alone (`node --test --test-name-pattern='scatter: firstPaint' tests/js/listpanes.test.mjs`). Find the root cause (timer/idle/settle race in the test harness or a real latch race in scatter.js) and fix it deterministically; prove with 30 consecutive passes, and run the whole tests/js suite.
4. Docs for committed WPD2/WPD3 work (see git show e9d1f3d 8761007 1ffbb37 and docs/js.md): IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES entries for (a) WPD2's sky-pane write rule (view origin store/beat/explicit/user; a view or overlay set a beat applied is implied by beat= and is not written to the hash; user pan/zoom/toggle after the beat writes sky=/ovl=; '#sky=..&beat=' keeps the hash view) and the beat markers (sky.beatView/sky.beatOvl, hash.js BEAT_VIEW/BEAT_OVL/skyImplied); (b) WPD3's startup rules (static skeletons, the list requests rows at startup, boot warmPaneModules prefetch, layout shownAtLoad/tabModeQuery) and the perf timing rule (timed from page.goto after one untimed warm-up page; PK_PERF_WARMUP=0 disables the warm-up; first_paint_from_open_s is reported, not budgeted). Matching ARCHITECTURE edits: §6.2/§6.4 (beatView/beatOvl and the hash rule) and §13 (perf timing). Number new notes after the current last entry.
5. Synthetic fixture: add a highlight-only narrative beat (a beat with a highlight and no view) to tests/fixtures/make_synthetic.py, additively (do not change existing fixture ids, rows or pages), and a test of the narrative:highlight goto condition documented in docs/js.md. Changing make_synthetic.py changes the fixture stamp, so regenerate your own PK_SYNTH_DIR under scratch.

title: Wave E: Python follow-ups (template paths, deploy manifest exposure, exposure scan cost, robitaille nouns/replace, bundle docs)
description:
Follow-ups recorded by WPE1 (commit 58188c6; read its IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 115-118 and ARCHITECTURE §9.3 edits).
1. portalkit/physics/templates.py load_source sets meta.source = str(path), an absolute local path. The build now labels it on the way out (LabellingWriter), but a direct physics.write_shared call writes it unlabelled. Write a basename or '<label>:<relpath>' at the source, consistent with PathLabeler in build.py. Test it.
2. deploy writes <target>/.portalkit-deploy.json (ownership manifest) into the served target with absolute paths (target, legacy_modules). Make deploy/htaccess.py deny it (and any other dot-manifest deploy writes into a target), test that, and document it in docs/deploy.md. If deploy.py must change, record the exact change in contract_issues (deploy.py is not yours).
3. Exposure scan cost. A cold robitaille adapter-test run took 622 s, about 608 s of it in fixture setup where py-spy showed portalkit/deploy/exposure.py scanning served roots and reading cold Lustre metadata (warm rerun 19 s). Profile the scan (count os.scandir/stat/readlink calls on the real served roots), then make it cheaper without changing any classification: e.g. prune subtrees that cannot hold a symlink into the queried path, stop at the first answer, scan only what a query needs, and/or memoise per process and on disk keyed by a cheap stamp. Report before/after call counts and wall time on the real roots. tests/py/test_exposure.py must keep every existing case and add cases for the new pruning/caching.
4. adapters/robitaille.py: set the WPE1 spec field noun=('model','models') on the 'mod' catalog so portal.json counts read '48 models'. sites/robitaille.toml: map the imaging page's legacy files with the WPE1 table form {file='imaging/index.html', replace=false} and {file='imaging/gallery.html', replace=false} (check they exist under legacy_dir first, read-only) and update the comment block. Adapter tests (python -m pytest tests/adapters/test_robitaille.py -m adapters) with PK_CACHE_DIR=<scratch>/WPE3/cache seeded by `cp -a` from /blue/adamginsburg/adamginsburg/portalkit_cache/robitaille (never write that cache).
5. docs/bundle.md section 8 still documents catalog.first_paint_files(manifest); document first_paint_files(manifest, context=True) and the context rule (manifest plus density grids only).
6. docs/inventory.json lacks pngs/gallery_6927_2221.html and pngs/gallery_6927_1182.html, which exist and are mapped with presets in sites/nirspec6927.toml. Add them in the way that keeps the parity/inventory tests coherent (e.g. as additional legacy files of the existing gallery row, or as rows if the 87-page counts are derived), updating tests/data/inventory_caps.json and tests/py/test_parity_inventory.py only as needed.
ARCHITECTURE.md and IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md are owned by WPE2 in this wave: put the exact text you need there in contract_issues.

title: Wave E: integrator follow-ups from WPE2/WPE3/WP23 (narrative re-entry, raf binding, preset select-all, deploy deny rules, exposure test cost, docs)
description:
Follow-ups recorded by WPE2 (d72d730), WPE3 (261055b) and WP23 (6c17f73). Read their commits and the contract_issues quoted here.
1. narrative.js re-entry (WPE2): with instant scrolling (prefers-reduced-motion makes .pk-nar-scroll use scroll-behavior auto) `activate(k, {scroll: true, keep})` calls scrollIntoView and then arrived() before it sets S.current; arrived() -> unpin() -> pickActive() -> activate(k) runs again without `keep` and emits narrative:highlight with goto:true, so '#sky=..&beat=<highlight-only beat>' loses the deep-link view. Fix (set S.current and section classes before the scroll, or call arrived() after the state update), and turn the `todo` test in tests/js/plotpanes.test.mjs ('deep-link view kept over the beat with an instant scroll') into a normal passing test. Keep WPD2's beat-marker hash rule (IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 119, ARCHITECTURE §6.2/§6.4) intact; run tests/e2e/test_deep_links.py and the narrative e2e tests in tests/e2e/test_archetype_smoke.py.
2. web/js/ui/controls.js line 44 binds `raf` at import time; scatter.js now looks requestAnimationFrame up at call time (IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 123). Do the same in controls.js and add a deterministic node test.
3. tests/e2e/test_port_sgrb2.py: update the stale comment 'counts come from the search manifests' (the landing pane reads portal.json counts[] first since WPE2). Comment only unless the assertion is wrong.
4. portalkit/bundle/images.py (WP23): a preset facet value that no item has is dropped, and an empty value list then passes everything, so a preset whose values all vanish becomes select-all. Make such a preset select nothing in a well-defined way (drop the preset with a warning, or keep it with an explicit empty match per the images JSON contract and the gallery pane's reading of presets; check web/js/panes/gallery.js read-only and choose the reading that needs no JS change, or record the JS change in contract_issues). Test it.
5. Deploy bookkeeping exposure (WPE3; docs/deploy.md '.htaccess'): (a) backup.py must call htaccess.write_backup_htaccess(legacy_dir, dry_run) whenever it creates <legacy_dir>/.portalkit_backup/; (b) deploy.py writes the deny block for .portalkit* / *.pk-tmp even without --htaccess (as a minimal managed .htaccess with the marker and the deny rule only, when the target has no foreign .htaccess; keep the --htaccess cache-header block as is; a foreign .htaccess stays an ownership conflict only when --htaccess is passed, otherwise warn and leave it); (c) devserver.py answers 403 for paths where htaccess.denied(rel) is true; (d) verify.py --http checks that <portal URL>/.portalkit-deploy.json answers 403 (or 404) when the target has the portalkit .htaccess, reporting a warning otherwise. Tests for each, deploy --dry-run and --target under scratch only.
6. Exposure scan cost in tests (WPE3 measured 589 s cold / ~10 s warm for a fresh walk; a stamp revalidation still makes ~88k stat/lstat calls). Add an env override PK_EXPOSURE_CACHE_S read by scan()'s default cache_s (documented as a test/dev convenience; the deploy CLI keeps its default unless the user sets it) and have tests/conftest.py set it to a day for the adapter tests only when the user has not set it, so adapter tests reuse the user's last scan read-only from ~/.cache/portalkit. Do not weaken classification for real deploys. Test the env parsing (bad values ignored).
7. Docs (owned here this wave): ARCHITECTURE §9.3 (load_source now writes source_label(path, labeler), file:<basename> by default; templates.write takes the labeler from a LabellingWriter dest so the build stages the root label), §11.2 (exposure cache format 3 with per-directory (dev, ino, mtime_ns, ctime_ns) stamps, one listing per real directory, read-only fallback to ~/.cache/portalkit, PK_EXPOSURE_CACHE_S), §11.5 (the .htaccess deny rule '<IfModule mod_alias.c> RedirectMatch 403 "/\.portalkit[^/]*(/|$)|\.pk-tmp$" </IfModule>', FileInfo class, and the item-5 behaviour). IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES entries (after the current last, 123): WPE3 items (templates labelled at source; htaccess deny; robitaille 'mod' noun=('model','models') and imaging legacy files with replace=false; exposure stamps), WP23 (adapters/dirgallery_sites.py exceeds the §9.5 400-line target because the GALLERIES registry is data the site toml schema has no place for; legacy files reached only through served symlinks are mapped replace=false because deploy stubs are relative and deploy refuses symlink components; portal.json 'related' links public portals to secure gallery URLs, links only), and this WP's items. docs/deploy.md and docs/js.md for items 1, 2, 5, 6.

title: Wave E: JS follow-ups from waves 3-4 (manifold default frame, hash speed/dim alias/spherex-colours, chip presets, spectrum readout, context rasters, foreign records)
description:
Contract issues from the wave-3/4 adapter reviews (commits 5849cde wd2, 2197971 nirspec2640, 40f3047 sickle_brick, 9b0bc5c spherex, efa679f jwst_archive). Each fix needs a node test.
1. boot.js (~line 258) ignores manifest.manifold.default_frame and manifold.js (~line 362) initialises its preset to 'pca'. Use default_frame when given; 'pca' only as fallback.
2. legacyhash.js drops `?speed=` (wavelength and manifold grammars); add canonical `speed` per (D) below and honour it in the manifold/tour.
3. legacy dim alias per (B) below; spherex-colours grammar per (C).
4. chips.js applyPreset ignores shift/alt modifiers for `r:` (range) presets; make shift add and alt subtract as for the other preset kinds.
5. spectrum1d.js updateReadout skips records whose segments are not sorted (sorted=false); search each segment (binary search when sorted, linear scan otherwise) so the hover readout works on multi-segment/unsorted records.
6. scatter.js statGrids reads only its own dataset's density grids; also read the context dataset's grids, and add a raster on/off toggle in the pane controls (state key persisted in the hash like other pane toggles).
7. gallery.js applies only preset facets; also honour preset.data.role (jwst_archive gallery presets carry {facets, role}).
8. data/records.js normalizeRecord ignores the record meta `fluxscale` (a multiplicative factor on flux channels); apply it.
9. Foreign record sets per (A) below (records.js / client.js / worker as needed).
Update docs/js.md. Put needed Python changes in contract_issues (WPE6 runs concurrently and owns the Python side of A-C).

title: Wave E: Python follow-ups from waves 3-4 (foreign records, dim alias, grammars, filters, manifold payload, templates size, checklist diff, deploy leftovers, docs)
description:
Contract issues from the wave-3/4 adapter reviews (commits 5849cde wd2, 2197971 nirspec2640, 40f3047 sickle_brick, 9b0bc5c spherex, efa679f jwst_archive) and WPE4 review leftovers. Each fix needs a pytest.
1. Foreign record sets per (A) below: spec.py ForeignRecords + RecordSetSpec.foreign, build.py/records.py skip writing shards and emit base/id_column in portal.json, schema validation, `portalkit check` and verify --http handling, visibility rule.
2. Legacy dim alias per (B) below in config.py (validation + pass-through) and legacy/hashmap.py if it maps dims; 'spherex-colours' grammar per (C) in schema.GRAMMARS.
3. config.py state frame validation rejects axes presets in a manifold page's initial state (wd2 report); accept them.
4. HST WFC3 filters are missing from the filter registry (wd2 needs at least F110W, F160W, F127M, F139M, F153M of WFC3/IR and F555W, F814W of WFC3/UVIS/ACS as the legacy wd2 uses; check adapters/wd2.py for the exact list it works around). Add them with SVO-derived zero points and pivot wavelengths in the same format as the existing rows; if transmission curves are stored, add them from SVO (network may be unavailable: then derive from the legacy code paths or record in contract_issues).
5. legacy/manifold_payload.convert should detect virtual colours (dims that are differences of two stored mags) and emit them as virtual instead of stored columns.
6. Template 'high' records are 46-49 kB, above the 40,960-byte soft record limit: reduce (e.g. split the grid into two records, or decimate the high grid beyond 5.3 um where it is a smooth blackbody) keeping the existing tests green.
7. bundle/records.py encode_pks1 requires a channel named 'flux' even for kind 'sedcurve'; allow any channel set for sedcurve (spherex wants legend 'SPHEREx'/'IRS').
8. spec.catalog_from_rows types an all-None mag/value/flag field as str; use the declared role (float/flag) instead.
9. cli.py checklist_diff matches Filename exactly; the checklist stores absolute x1d paths while served exports carry '<stem>/<x1d>' relative paths. Match Filename by path suffix (basename plus parent dir). Then remove the two xfail markers WP28 added (tests/adapters/test_jwst_archive.py and tests/e2e/test_port_jwst_archive.py) -- those two test files are also yours for this item only. Never write the checklist CSV.
10. WPE4 leftovers: verify.py check_manifest_denied treats a 500 as 'served' (report 5xx as probable AllowOverride rejection, consistent with ARCHITECTURE §11); htaccess.py reads the owned .htaccess with errors='replace' but _write_owned compares with strict utf-8 (make them consistent; never crash on a non-UTF-8 owned file); IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 129 'related' wording (the WP23 links are landing cards).
11. Docs: ARCHITECTURE file layout lists portalkit/legacy/nirspec.py; section 15 WP28 and port_table text 'jwst/spectra/portal/unified' -> 'jwst/spectra/portal_unified'; deploy.md gets a spherex runbook entry replacing deploy_portal.sh (build / deploy --dry-run / deploy / verify --http); record that the legacy portal at mastDownload/JWST/pngs/portal is publicly reachable through the pngs/portal symlink (user decision).
Put needed JS changes in contract_issues (WPE5 runs concurrently).

title: Wave E: adapters adopt WPE5/WPE6 features (foreign records, dim alias, grammars, shared NIRSpec helper)
description:
Adopt the framework features WPE5 and WPE6 just added (read their commits/diffs and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md):
1. wd2: the wd2 manifold shows the nirspec2640 spectra through a foreign record set (secure->secure or public as appropriate per the two sites' visibility); drop any wd2 workaround for HST filters now in the registry; use default_frame / axes presets if the adapter worked around them.
2. jwst_archive: the W51 archive_colors portal and the gallery portal reference the archive portal's spectrum shards as foreign records instead of their own ~15 MB copies (respect the visibility rule: a public gallery may not point at secure shards -- keep its copy if so, and record why).
3. spherex: legacy dim alias map for the manifold kv-view hashes (m_F162M -> f162m, c_F162M_F210M -> f162m-f210m etc.), the 'spherex-colours' grammar for colours.html, sedcurve channels named SPHEREx/IRS.
4. nirspec6927: switch to the shared portalkit/legacy/nirspec.py helpers (added by WP25 for nirspec2640) instead of its own copies; keep output identical (compare a limit=50 build before/after: same served JSON except hashes).
5. nirspec2640: only if needed to serve as a foreign record base (stable key, documented URL).
Run each touched family's adapter tests and its e2e test; run one bounded build per touched family through `portalkit check --gate G2`.

title: Wave E: JS follow-ups from WPE5-7/WP29-31 (foreign has/get, wavelength speed, axes frame, hash goldens)
description:
Contract issues recorded by WPE5, WPE6, WPE7, WP29, WP30 and WP31 (full text: /blue/adamginsburg/adamginsburg/tmp/claude-3663/-orange-adamginsburg-jwst-spectra/048f7b00-b5fa-4299-b8f1-b80065e6a3d8/scratchpad/unify/waveE5_issues.txt). Each fix needs a test.
1. spectrum2d.js (~400) and ui/hover.js (~430) use the optimistic sync rs.has(id); for foreign id_column record sets await rs.hasRecord(id) when available, and treat a null get() for the focused row as 'no record' (as spectrum1d does).
2. hub.js: resolve PNG-mode sidecars ({png}) of a foreign record set against entry.base, so non-boot users of createHub match boot.
3. wavelength.js reads ?speed= from location.search, but boot strips consumed query keys; read the store key 'speed' (default options.speed or 1) and subscribe to it.
4. manifold.js: accept an axes preset (kind 'axes', data {x, y, xr?, yr?}) as the frame in state 'frame:<id>'.preset and options.frame (config.py already validates this). tour.js orthonormalizes every frame, so an axes preset whose x and y share a band (CMD: a-b vs a) is distorted: render axes-preset frames as a plain 2-D projection of the two dims (no orthonormalization) and resume touring from the nearest orthonormal frame when the tour starts.
5. hash_vectors.json (shared JS/Python parity goldens): add vectors for dim_alias, spherex-colours and ?speed= (wavelength and kv-view), including spherex-colours on a one-scatter page (band/cmd dropped). Then remove the SPEED_DIVERGENT / PENDING_VECTORS work-arounds from tests/js/legacyhash.test.mjs. tests/py/test_hashmap.py carries matching tables: WPE9 (concurrent, owns tests/py) removes them; list in contract_issues exactly what changed.
6. legacyhash.js gc-query: the legacy default CMD (a/b/m, Treasury y-band toggle, p=ccd x1..y2) must reach the scatter pane named by page.legacy.cmd_pane when present (gc_manifold pages put the CMD in scatter pane 'cmd'), instead of only <manifold>.frame. WPE9 mirrors this in the Python mapper from this description: the key is page.legacy.cmd_pane (string pane id); with it, a/b/m set <cmd_pane>.x = a-b and <cmd_pane>.y = m, and p=ccd x1..y2 still go to <manifold>.frame.
Update docs/js.md.

title: Wave E: Python follow-ups from WPE5-7/WP29-31 (gc_manifest metadata+paths, related links, preset roles, devserver mounts, caps, exposure tests, docs)
description:
Contract issues recorded by WPE5, WPE6, WPE7, WP29, WP30 and WP31 (full text: /blue/adamginsburg/adamginsburg/tmp/claude-3663/-orange-adamginsburg-jwst-spectra/048f7b00-b5fa-4299-b8f1-b80065e6a3d8/scratchpad/unify/waveE5_issues.txt). Each fix needs a test.
1. legacy/gc_manifest.write drops most CatalogSpec metadata from the served pk-catalog manifest (presets incl. the red_clump filter and cmd/ccd axes presets, virtual dims, column filter ids, id/search metadata, ManifoldSpec frames/default_frame); merge them. It also writes absolute local paths into provenance.foreign.manifest and provenance.gc_*, so `portalkit check --gate G2` fails for every gc_manifold portal: label them with build.PathLabeler.
2. build.py portal_doc fills `related` from fb.site.portals without checking that each portal was built (gc_manifold skips sgrb2_manifold): include only built portals.
3. sites/gc_monitor.toml: register the jwst-gc monitor with status = "excluded" per section 4.1 so readmes may link it; adjust the site loader if it needs a minimal family entry.
4. bundle/images.py gallery presets: emit preset 'role' (and data.role) when the Preset carries one; gallery.js applies it.
5. caps.py auto layout collapses the foreign spectrum1d pane on wd2_manifold; a page's only spectrum view should open expanded (and an explicit PaneSpec collapsed=False must win).
6. deploy/devserver.py: option to mount sibling portals at deploy-relative URL paths (e.g. mounts={'/jwst/spectra/portal_unified/': <staged dir>}; CLI --mount PREFIX=DIR) so foreign bases like '../../../../jwst/spectra/portal_unified/data/' resolve in e2e without per-test routing; expose it to tests via a fixture in tests/conftest.py. Denied-path 403 rules apply inside mounts too.
7. tests/py/test_exposure.py test_stamps_detect_permission_change and test_stamps_detect_link_swap_with_restored_mtime fail when TMPDIR is on /blue (Lustre); make them robust (skip with reason when a probe shows the filesystem does not update ctime on chmod/link swap).
8. legacy/hashmap.py: mirror WPE8 item 6 (page.legacy.cmd_pane) and the ?speed= handling; drop the SPEED_DIVERGENT/PENDING tables in tests/py/test_hashmap.py once the shared hash_vectors.json carries the vectors (WPE8 owns that file and runs concurrently; if it is not updated when you finish, keep the tables and say so). config.py validates page.legacy.cmd_pane names a scatter pane of the page.
9. ARCHITECTURE section 6.2/6.4: list store key 'speed', 'layers:<pane>' {raster?, ovl?}, hash keys <pane>.xr/.yr/.raster/.ovl, speed, and page.legacy.cmd_pane. docs/wps.json is NOT yours.
Put needed JS changes in contract_issues.

title: Adapter: extras jwst_gc_aladin explorer + cmd_explorer pre-binned explorer
description: The two 'extras' rows of ARCHITECTURE section 14 / docs/port_table.json that WP31 could not build (no files were assigned). Locate the legacy pages and generators (search /orange/adamginsburg to depth ~6 for jwst_gc_aladin.html and cmd_explorer*; the inventory says jwst_gc_aladin.html uses catalog HiPS from jwst_gc_pipeline/cmz/hipsgen.py via Hipsgen-cat, and cmd_explorer pre-bins 4.7M stars into a ~1.4 MB JSON). jwst_gc_aladin: explorer [sky] with catalog-HiPS layers as overlays and GC catalogs via skyWindow; flags sky cat skycat dens. cmd_explorer: explorer with pre-binned density grids as a first-class dataset (bundle/density.py); flags multi cat num2 mags2 num3 dens; brushes, linked selection, selectable axes. Follow committed adapters (adapters/hips_tours.py, adapters/spitzer_spectra.py, adapters/robitaille.py) and docs/adapters.md. Contract tests at limit 50, one e2e file, one bounded build through `portalkit check --gate G2`. If a legacy source cannot be found, report it in contract_issues and implement what the data allows.

title: Wave E: adapters adopt WPE8/WPE9 (gc_manifold metadata, spherex default frame, jwst_archive preset roles, devserver mounts)
description:
Adopt WPE8/WPE9 (read their diffs and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md):
1. gc_manifold: remove the GC_MANIFEST_GAP_CAPS/FLAGS work-arounds and the xfail on test_fixture_build_full_g2 now that gc_manifest keeps presets/frames and labels paths; set page.legacy.cmd_pane for the CMD scatter pane; serve the red-clump preset as a manifest preset.
2. spherex: manifold.default_frame 'default' names no preset; emit a real preset key.
3. jwst_archive: gallery presets carry role through images.py (drop the per-file '&role=' stub work-around only if equivalent).
4. wd2 and jwst_archive e2e: use the devserver sibling mount instead of per-test routing for foreign bases.
Run each touched family's adapter and e2e tests and one bounded build through `portalkit check --gate G2`.

title: Integration: close cross-WP gaps (cmd_pane, preset role, frame representation, wavelength speed, foreign mounts) and make the whole e2e suite green
description:
Sole WP running: you may edit any file under the listed paths. Read commits 24ecbbf (WPE8), 2033c08 (WPE9), 8321f4c (WP32), 620ec76 (WPE10) and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md 140+.
1. page.legacy.cmd_pane is unreachable end to end: add cmd_pane to spec.LegacyRef, propagate it in build.py _merge_legacy (adapter-set values must survive merging with the site TOML), add it to both page.legacy allowlists in schema.py, and set it in adapters/gc_manifold.py for the CMD scatter pane. Python hashmap and JS legacyhash already route on it.
2. schema.validate_images preset allowlist lacks 'role' although bundle/images.py emits it and gallery.js reads it: allow it, then let adapters/jwst_archive.py serve its role-carrying gallery presets in the dropdown (drop the filter work-around).
3. Manifold frame representation after WPE8's raw axes frames: tests/e2e/test_port_wd2.py::test_sabbi_manifold expects the default_frame axes preset to report its virtual dim name ('m_hst_v-m_hst_h') but gets the decomposed base dims; test_port_spherex.py::test_legacy_hash_focus[...view=co_ice] gets a zero frame for a named axes preset; test_port_gc_manifold.py::test_gc_query_cmd_and_ccd_frames is flaky and its frame is orthonormalized (gc-query frames carry no preset). Decide one consistent rule (recommended: an axes preset or gc-query a/b/m CMD is shown as the raw 2-D projection of its expressions; stats()/test hooks report the preset's expression names; tours start from the nearest orthonormal frame) and fix code and tests to match; remove the flakiness (find its race).
4. tests/e2e/test_port_wd2.py::test_wavelength_rungs_and_speed: ?speed=2 never reaches the wavelength pane after WPE8 moved it to the store key 'speed'; fix the boot/legacyhash/wavelength path.
5. tests/e2e/test_port_wd2.py::test_manifold_legacy_kv_hash 404s because the nirspec2640 sibling mount is populated by a later test; make the foreign-portal mount a module-scoped fixture built before any test that loads wd2_manifold.
6. Then run EVERY e2e file (python -m pytest tests/e2e -m e2e --run-e2e -q, with PK_SYNTH_DIR and PK_CACHE_DIR under your scratch; it is slow on this loaded host -- run files one at a time and re-run a failure once before treating it as real), the adapters suite (tests/adapters --run-adapters), tests/py and the node suite, and fix every real failure. Report the per-file e2e pass/fail table. Treat a timing-only assertion that fails once and passes on re-run as load, and say so.
